historical_metrics_policy: Reference metrics are reused from SHA-bound previously accepted CSVs; their original models are not newly rescored here.

historical_reporting_disclosure.explanation: Do not attribute all historical source drift to the October 20 authorized manuscript integration; preserve original bound, pre-integration and current versions separately.

report_provenance.policy: Old scientific and reporting files are read-only; no old hash or result is rewritten.

reporting_exception_policy: None. New scientific sources are all strictly SHA checked. Historical report drift is disclosure only.
